title.zh: 模型建立：几何与材料假设决定解释方式
title.en: Model building: geometry and material assumptions define interpretation

subtitle.zh: 将真实结构转为可计算、可验证的参数模型
subtitle.en: Turn real structures into computable, verifiable parameter models

body.zh: 保留影响响应的关键特征，避免无依据增加自由参数。图示顶部 CD、底部 CD、高度、侧壁角、层堆栈与材料光学常数 n/k（随波长变化）。几何存在约束关系，不应全部独立拟合。
body.en: Retain response-relevant features without unjustified free parameters. Labels include top/bottom CD, height, sidewall angle, stack, wavelength-dependent optical constants n/k. Geometric constraints mean these should not all be fitted independently.

body.zh: 堆栈与形貌 → 几何参数 → 材料 n/k → 电磁计算 → 灵敏度与参考验证。关键控制为层堆栈、几何参数化、光学常数 n/k、参数约束。
body.en: Stack/profile → geometry parameters → material n/k → electromagnetic calculation → sensitivity/reference validation. Control stack, geometric parameterization, n/k, and parameter constraints.

body.zh: 过简会遗漏形貌而无法正确解释响应；过复杂会增加参数相关性，降低稳定性。漏层、错误 n/k、不合理参数约束都可能造成偏差。
body.en: Oversimplification omits profile features and misinterprets response; excessive complexity increases parameter correlation and reduces stability. Missing layers, wrong n/k, or unreasonable constraints can cause bias.

body.zh: 检查残差形态、参考偏差和不同模型版本的参数稳定性，支持修订与重新验证。模型适用性影响跨批次可比性；结构或材料变化时，需评估旧模型是否仍适用。
body.en: Inspect residual shape, reference bias, and parameter stability across model versions to support revisions/revalidation. Applicability affects cross-lot comparability; reevaluate old models after structure/material changes.

uncertain: 页末水印与实质文字或图示区域重叠；figureCrop保留完整图表，未猜测补画遮挡区域。
